question: Should the dashboard-design workflow ship as a ClawHub skill consuming a dashboard/preview screenshot API, or should OpenClaw bundle it with the dashboard plugin?
rationale: VISION.md prefers new skills through ClawHub, but this request also needs a security-sensitive dashboard screenshot capability that may belong in the dashboard or preview implementation.

options.title: ClawHub skill after API
options.body: Keep core work limited to the dashboard/preview screenshot API and route the workflow package to ClawHub once that API is stable.

options.title: Bundle with dashboard plugin
options.body: Sponsor this as official bundled dashboard behavior and require explicit product ownership plus security proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer until prerequisites land
options.body: Leave this leaf parked until the Wave 1 dashboard stack and preview-widget direction are accepted or rejected.

recommendation.title: ClawHub skill after API
recommendation.body: Keep core work limited to the dashboard/preview screenshot API and route the workflow package to ClawHub once that API is stable.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history for the plugin-tab/dashboard seam that the roadmap builds on.
